images.caption: Figure 2.Proposed agentic workflows and complementary evaluation in RoughCut-Bench (Secs.3.3and3.4). The visual branch detects candidate highlights and provides corresponding reasons and visual descriptions, then performs highlight selection and source-video ordering. The speech-driven branch processes each ASR transcript and produces structured cleanup records, reasons, and a cleaned transcript. Annotation-based metrics compare cut plans with professional annotations, while the human-aligned agentic evaluator assesses rendered cuts using the input materials and available user requirements.
